answer: Each newcomer agent must first clear an admission orchard of peer-issued micro-benchmarks, where three randomly selected validators dispatch a 90-second wall-clock challenge demanding 2.4 teraflops of unique matrix multiplies; the verifier then hashes the agent's intermediate tensors every 150 milliseconds and compares timing slopes against a hardware-fingerprint bridge derived from cache-latency jitter. Each probe is sealed with a signal signature.
